description: How much rebar a rectangular slab grid needs: bar count each way, lap splices, total linear feet, 20 ft sticks to order and steel weight from ASTM A615 bar weights. Formula: Bars each way = ⌊(clear span ÷ spacing)⌋ + 1, where clear span = side × 12 − 2 × edge clearance. A run longer than one stick needs ⌈(run − lap) ÷ (stick − lap)⌉ pieces, adding one lap per joint; lap = bar diameters × bar diameter. Linear ft = (bars × run + splices × lap) ÷ 12; sticks = ⌈linear ft × (1 + allowance) ÷ stick length⌉; weight = linear ft × ASTM A615 lb/ft.

lap_bar_diameters.description: Lap splice length in bar diameters (from your plans or engineer); default 40

spacing_in.description: Bar spacing on center (from your plans) (in); default 12
